items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that something that Selmer had a hand in? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. That’s right.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know you were doing the other part of the interview and I think you got to 1926 or somewhere in there. But in 1951 Al recorded “Saxophone Contrasts” CD I mean album. And that probably has been the most requested on the Internet. Where can I get a hold of the recordings from “Saxophone Contrasts” “Saxophone Contrasts.” That was 1951. And he followed it up in 1958 with another album “Gallodoro” was the title for your listening pleasure. We’re not quite sure what the title of that one was, but that was in…
Was that something that Selmer had a hand in?
